signature_moves: Monospace-everything on '+'-tick graph paper with paper noise — full commitment to a drafting-table / engineering-notebook register (softened Terminal-hacker family); the single decision that defines the app
Inverted note polarity — near-black #2F2E2D tiles with light text on a pale board, vs the pastel-sticky default; maximal figure-ground, cards read as physical objects
Hand-drawn bezier connectors + rendered pen-nib cursor — organic warmth against the rigid mono grid (Excalidraw-adjacent craft gesture)
Visible keyboard accelerators printed on tools (Pen 2, Eraser 3) — discoverability/expert signal in the chrome
defects: Contrast Dilution — breadcrumb #A2A2A2 on #ECECEC ~2.1:1 and 'Clear Canvas' ~#444 on #2F2E2D ~1.2:1; de-emphasis pushed past the 4.5:1 text floor
UI-contrast shortfall — unchecked checkbox #5E5D5C on card #2F2E2D ~2.1:1, below the 3:1 non-text floor
Flat in-card hierarchy (minor) — card titles share mono size/weight/colour with their checklist items; hierarchy rests only on position + checkbox glyphs
Accent not bound to system accent (native deviation) — fixed brand yellow is the sole saturated colour, no visible selection/focus grammar; house-style tell, not mac canon

aesthetic.direction: engineering-notebook / drafting-table terminal — Terminal-hacker family (mono everywhere, graph-paper grid) crossed with Industrial/utilitarian (ruler/spec ticks), softened by rounded dark tiles, hand-drawn connectors and paper grain (a touch of Organic/soft)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — the single yellow tool is the one saturated element on an otherwise mono-grey board; the active tool pops and is remembered
Information scent / discoverability — keyboard-accelerator numerals on tools let expert users predict and reach commands fast
Jakob's Law — conventional native frame (genuine traffic lights, breadcrumb path) honours trained expectations; the innovation is spent on the product (mono canvas), not the interface
Aesthetic-usability effect — a fully coherent mono+grid+texture system reads as intentional and trustworthy (first-contact halo)

Processing-fluency VIOLATION — breadcrumb ~2.1:1 and 'Clear Canvas' ~1.2:1 create legibility friction ('something feels off'); Fitts's Law is otherwise well served by large cards and a chunky ~44pt tool bar
notes: Single surface only, from a marketing COVER composite (blue-gradient brand panel + wordmark 'forma' + headline 'The best native whiteboard for Mac' — brand evidence, not app design; the app window inside is the sole design evidence). No settings / empty-state / onboarding / dark-mode / other surfaces. App window is a scaled render (~1.8x, approx @2x) so all pixel values are (estimated) with wide error and absolute pt is anchored only to the native traffic-light cluster; colours are clean (measured) but single-surface (inferred). Whiteboard = custom-drawn canvas: contributes minimal native-CONTROL evidence — feeds a 'mono-canvas / drafting-table' cluster idea, NOT core macOS canon. Lineage native (med) is a frame judgement (real lights over a transparent titlebar, zero web-chrome tells); interior is brand-custom. No Liquid Glass present, which is CORRECT (content opaque) rather than a defect. icon.png is present in the source folder but was NOT digested (task scoped to Workflow A / UI only). The mo-su sparkline in the tool bar has no determinable function from a still — flagged ambiguous.
